{{Quote|I tell you, ''Franna''&mdash;we shouldn't have to leave. They're forcing us from our ''homes''!''"<br />"''Everyone else is already ''gone''. The Jedi Master is ''right''.|[[Thernbee (individual)|Thernbee]] and Franna|<ref name="Labyrinth" />}}
'''Franna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was part of a colony that resided on a [[Unidentified besieged moon|moon]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], knowing that this colony couldn't be saved from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] invasion, most of the population evacuated the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. Months later, in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] went on a [[Mission to unidentified besieged moon|mission]] to the besieged moon in order to evacuate the last of its population, including Franna.
